company_name: Jiangsu Rongdaoshe Semiconductor Equipment Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Jiangsu Rongdaoshe specializes in semiconductor lithography equipment and packaging solutions, making it a key player in the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Jiangsu Rongdaoshe Semiconductor Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced lithography equipment and wet-process tools for semiconductor packaging. The company offers integrated solutions for package-level packaging, focusing on enhancing production capacity and yield rates through automation and intelligent operations.
capabilities: I-line, G-line, and H-line lithography systems

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Fenhu High-Tech Zone, Wujiang, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, focusing on local technology development.
